answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks through bonded reputation: each identity must lock collateral before it can validate work or receive escrowed payments, and a randomly selected peer committee can challenge contradictory claims. If an agent is caught fabricating consensus, its bond and accumulated reputation are slashed, while honest validators are paid. A fake swarm therefore needs a separate funded bond for every prism, umber, and garden persona, making scale costly and coordinated fraud financially punishable.
